d: The Employee Relations Supervisor is responsible for overseeing day-to-day HR operations and employee relations activities, ensuring efficient HR service delivery, accurate payroll coordination, and compliance with Saudi Labor Law and company policies.

The role supports employees and operational teams across key HR processes, including attendance, leave management, payroll inputs, employee documentation, grievances, and disciplinary matters, while maintaining a positive and compliant work environment.
q: Team Supervision, Task Allocation & SLA Monitoring
Experience coordinating or supervising HR operational activities and guiding team members is preferred.
Familiarity with Saudi government HR platforms such as Qiwa, GOSI, and Muqeem, as relevant to the role, is an advantage.
r: Manage day-to-day HR operational activities, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of employee services.
Oversee employee records, employment contracts, documentation, and HR system updates.
Monitor employee attendance, absences, leave balances, and related HR transactions.
Coordinate employee onboarding, transfers, contract renewals, and offboarding procedures.
Support employees and line managers with HR-related requests and operational matters.
Ensure HR transactions are processed accurately and in accordance with internal policies and procedures.
Prepare, review, and validate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, overtime, allowances, deductions, and other payroll adjustments.
Coordinate with Payroll and Finance teams to ensure accurate and timely salary processing.
Review payroll discrepancies and support the resolution of employee salary-related inquiries.
Maintain accurate payroll-related records and supporting documentation.
Handle employee grievances, workplace complaints, disciplinary matters, and employee relations cases professionally and confidentially.
Conduct or support employee investigations, document findings, and recommend appropriate actions.
Ensure compliance with Saudi Labor Law, company policies, and internal disciplinary procedures.
Advise employees and line managers on HR policies, employee rights, and workplace conduct.
Coordinate with relevant stakeholders on employment disputes, disciplinary actions, and termination cases.
Promote fair and consistent employee relations practices across the organization.
Prepare regular HR reports covering attendance, employee movements, payroll-related issues, and employee relations cases.
Identify recurring HR operational issues and recommend process improvements.
Maintain accurate HR data and support internal audits and compliance requirements.
Work closely with Operations and HR stakeholders to improve service delivery and employee experience.
Supervise daily ER operations and allocate tasks among team members to ensure efficient service delivery.
Monitor team performance, workload distribution, and adherence to established SLAs.
Provide guidance and support to team members in handling complex employee relations cases.
Ensure consistency, accuracy, and timely completion of HR transactions across assigned locations.

Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented Project Manager (Saudi National) to join our team in Riyadh. The scope of work includes the construction of irrigation water tanks, irrigation networks, softscape and hardscape works, and extensive planting across seven neighborhoods within Riyadh City.

The Project Manager will be responsible for leading the planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of multidisciplinary landscape and infrastructure projects. Working closely with clients, consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders, the role ensures that projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with all technical, quality, and contractual requirements.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering, construction, or technical discipline.
Minimum 10 years of project management experience in construction, infrastructure, landscape, or multidisciplinary development projects.
Strong understanding of project delivery, construction management, contract administration, and stakeholder coordination.
Experience managing consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams in a complex project environment.
Knowledge of project budgeting, procurement processes, cost control, and financial management principles.
Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with health, safety, quality, and environmental requirements within construction projects.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver projects within schedule and budget constraints.
Professional certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management qualification.
Experience delivering large-scale landscape, public realm, irrigation, or urban infrastructure projects.
Knowledge of contract management, claims assessment, variation management, and extension-of-time evaluations.
Familiarity with scheduling and reporting tools such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and Power BI.
Experience working with government entities and major public-sector development programs in Saudi Arabia.
Strong understanding of Saudi Arabian construction regulations, project delivery practices, and stakeholder management requirements.

r: Lead and oversee the full project lifecycle, including planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout activities.
Manage and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders to achieve project objectives.
Direct design and engineering activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications, client requirements, and industry standards.
Coordinate with architects, design consultants, and technical teams to ensure design quality, functionality, and constructability.
Oversee construction activities on site, ensuring adherence to approved drawings, specifications, schedules, and safety requirements.
Monitor project budgets, procurement activities, contracts, and resource allocation to maintain cost-effectiveness and project profitability.
Implement effective risk management strategies and support mitigation measures to address project challenges and opportunities.
Ensure contractor compliance with approved health, safety, and environmental plans throughout project execution.
Supervise construction supervision consultants, inspectors, technicians, and support staff to maintain delivery excellence.
Monitor contractor performance, progress, productivity, and cost forecasts, providing regular status updates and recommendations.
Prepare and review monthly progress reports, project correspondence, executive summaries, and other project documentation.
Facilitate regular progress meetings with contractors, consultants, and client representatives to resolve issues and maintain project momentum.
Maintain daily coordination with client representatives and key stakeholders to ensure effective communication and project alignment.
Review contractor payment applications and support the timely processing of progress invoices.
Evaluate contractor claims, variation requests, extension-of-time submissions, and contractual matters, providing recommendations to project leadership.
Coordinate with utility providers and engineering disciplines to address technical challenges and support project delivery.
Review and validate as-built drawings and project handover documentation to ensure successful project completion.
